## About
A & C Auto Air & Radiator Service is a full service independent auto repair shop on Woodland Ave in San Rafael. We're locally owned and operated, and we work on American, Japanese and European cars and trucks.
Air conditioning and radiators are in our name, and we specialize in them. We also handle factory scheduled maintenance, brakes, transmissions, clutches and electrical diagnosis. And we're old car specialists, so collector and vintage cars and trucks are welcome here.
Our customers rate us 4.9 from 29 Google reviews. One reviewer put it simply: Tony and Chuck are the nicest guys, and they are great mechanics.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Repair and Service: Diagnosis and repair for your car's AC, from a simple recharge to bigger fixes.
- Radiator Repair and Maintenance: Leaks, hoses, caps and cooling system work to keep your engine from running hot.
- Factory Scheduled Maintenance: The service your manufacturer calls for, done on schedule.
- Oil Change & Lube: Routine oil and lube service for cars and trucks.
- C.V. Boots, Drum and Disk Brake Replacement: Brake and C.V. boot work for American, Japanese and European vehicles.
- Transmission Repairs and Clutch Service: Transmission repair and clutch work, plus drive train inspection and diagnosis.
- Electric Diagnostic: When the check engine light comes on, we track down the cause.
- Hot rod & vintage car repair: Preservation and repair for hot rods, collector cars and older trucks.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: American, Japanese and European cars and trucks, including Chevy, Ford, Jeep, Honda, Toyota, BMW, Mercedes and Volvo. We also work on hot rods and vintage cars.

Q: Do you work on classic and vintage cars?
A: Yes. We're old car specialists, and we take care of everything from hot rods to family SUVs.

Q: What parts do you use?
A: We use quality OEM or aftermarket replacement parts, and we stand by our work.
